findings.issue: The release's fee leg is a remainder, not a checked figure. fee_cents = offer_escrow balance minus allocated_subtotal_cents, and precondition 2 checks only fee_cents >= 0. A16's escrow.release takes every line's remaining sub-balance and checks only the payout_clearing leg and zero residual. Any investor money still in the offering's escrow that is not part of the allocation (a scale-back refund line that failed or was not executed, a late or duplicate credit, an unallocated line) would be moved into fee_payable_realx as RealX 'fees' under the 6E approval, and becomes sweepable to operating once the run settles. The offering.finalised fact carries no fee total or per-line allocation, so A39 cannot check it. Oracle invariant 2 constrains only the subtotal, so a wrong build passes.
findings.fix: Ask A38 to add allocated_fee_cents (and the per-line allocation hash or lines {order_id, allocated_cents, fee_cents}) to offering.finalised. Make precondition 2: fee_cents == allocated_fee_cents; offer_escrow balance == allocated_subtotal_cents + allocated_fee_cents exactly; every order line outside the allocation has a zero sub-balance and every allocated line's sub-balance == its allocated_cents + fee_cents. Otherwise refuse 409 ESC_ESCROW_RESIDUAL_UNEXPLAINED with a Sev1. Re-run it in the effector. Add it to oracle invariant 2 and challenge step 2 (a planted A$0.01 unrefunded scale-back line refuses the draft and never reaches fee_payable_realx).

findings.issue: A failed or returned trustee settlement has no recovery path. A16 routes a failed or returned escrow_settlement back to offer_escrow on the line settlement:<offering id>, and its catalogue row escrow.settlement_resend (4E TRSY -> CFO, caller A39) sends it again. A39 has no resend route, request, effector or state. escrow_settlement ends at failed or returned, and is unique per offering. Pass criteria require 'at most one bank settlement' per offering, and the SM-05 invariant allows only settled or held. So trustee money would stay stranded in the escrow trust account, and a correct resend would break the tests.
findings.fix: Add POST /v1/treasury/escrow/settlements/{id}/resend: TRSY is the maker, a staff token may draft as maker only, and A14 escrow.settlement_resend (4E TRSY -> CFO) runs over {escrow_settlement_id, amount_cents, settlement_account_version, fingerprint}. Its effector posts A16 escrow.settlement_resend and creates a new settlement attempt (attempt_no) that re-runs steps 1-6. Change the uniqueness to one non-terminal attempt per offering, with the settled attempts totalling the released amount exactly once. Add failed and returned to the SM-05 invariant as tracked states with an owner, a Sev2 and an A13 clock. Add a challenge: the sandbox fails the payout, the money lands on settlement:<offering>, and the resend pays exactly once.

findings.issue: Other surfaces that upstream nodes assign to A39 are not built here. In A16's catalogue, A39 is the caller for shortfall.topup (6E TRSY -> CFO + CCO, which makes good a client-money trust-account shortfall from operating after bank.shortfall), adjustment (ledger.adjustment 6E TRSY/REGO -> CFO + CCO, which A40 line 148 relies on for corrections to closed runs), rounding.sweep (4E TRSY -> CFO, drafted by TRSY on ledger.rounding_over_cap) and suspense.resolve (shared with A17). A17 line 57 says A39 registers OperatingReceiptSink. A39 says nothing about any of them, so the builder skips them and the owners' paths fail later.
findings.fix: Either add each to A39 (route, A14 row, effector, A16 journal, the A17 bank call where money moves, gate tests and agent-matrix rows: maker-only for staff tokens, never checker), or record each one under Spec dependencies as moved to a named node with a loop on A16 or A17 so that the caller column changes. At a minimum, shortfall.topup and OperatingReceiptSink need an owner before AM3 exits.

findings.issue: The withdrawal reservation can expire while the row still waits for approval. The boot check covers co-sign + 72 h + release window for a single pass. But held -> checking -> awaiting_approval (after a TRSY re-check, a lifted AML restriction or confirm-destination) starts a new 72 h approval on the same reservation. The reservation-sweep expiry row lists requested, checking, held and approved, but not awaiting_approval, so an approval can land on an expired reservation and withdrawal.pay has nothing to consume. A16 also gives no default for ledger.withdrawal.reservation_ttl_hours, so the boot check has no known value to pass.
findings.fix: On every re-entry to checking, re-reserve or extend the reservation to cover a full approval TTL + release window, or refuse re-entry and require a new request. Add awaiting_approval -> expired (A16 reservation sweep; the A14 request is cancelled) to SM-WDR. Request an A16 default of at least 98 h through a named loop. Add an oracle case: hold, lift after 60 h, then approve at 71 h on the new request.

findings.issue: Refund-to-bank can deadlock A38. A38 R4 waits for 'every payout settled' (A17 payout.settled) when return_to_bank is on. A39 can close a refund payout as cancelled: retained_in_wallet or returned, and emits treasury.refund_payout.resolved, which A38 does not consume. Spec dependencies do not ask A38 to change, so a refund with no nominated account leaves the A38 run open forever.
findings.fix: Add a Spec dependency: A38 R4 consumes treasury.refund_payout.resolved {source_event_id, state} and treats settled, retained_in_wallet and returned as terminal. Put the A38 source event id in A38's settlement.refund.return_to_bank payload. Add a contract test against A38's fixture.

findings.issue: Distribution data is read from a node that is not an ancestor. payouts_queued_cents (which must reproduce A$96,214.30), the runway job ('distribution runs approved and due in the window') and A74's requested summary field 'runs awaiting funding' all need A40's run schedule and state. A40 is not a dependency, and A16 balances do not carry due dates. The A06 seed change the spec needs (approved withdrawals plus due distribution payables = A$96,214.30) is not listed under Spec dependencies.
findings.fix: Define a DistributionScheduleProvider port in A39 {dueRuns(accountRef, from, to) -> [{run_id, vehicle_id, due_date, payable_cents, funded}]}, registered by A40 or A49 (A40 does not depend on A39, so an A39 -> A40 edge also has no cycle). Until it is registered, return a 'distributions_unavailable' flag rather than 0. Add the A06 seed request to Spec dependencies, and state which A74 A39.1 fields (allowed_actions on returns, transfers, sweeps, float and accounts; runs awaiting funding) are delivered.

findings.issue: The payout id on the ledger leg is undefined. A16 requires every payout_clearing credit to carry line_ref = payout:<payout id> and write a ledger_payout row at posting. But A39 posts withdrawal.pay before A17's createPayout returns its payoutId, and escrow.release possibly days before the settlement payout exists (the held settlement steps). Neither spec says which id links the ledger payout row to A17's payout and its settle, failure and return events.
findings.fix: State that A39 pre-assigns the payout reference (the WDR id, or the escrow_settlement attempt id) and uses it both as A16's payout:<id> and as A17's idempotencyKey or reference. Add to A17.1 that A17 keys ledger_payout and its payout.* events by that caller reference. Test that a payout.failed maps back to the exact ledger_payout row.

findings.issue: The 4E checker order is claimed but cannot be enforced. The table says [[TRSY],[CFO]] 'in that order', and SM-WDR says 'TRSY and then the CFO'. A14 has no ordered checker sets, and the G13 challenge has the CFO deciding first.
findings.fix: Drop 'in that order' (any order, two distinct humans), or request ordered checker sets from A14 as a named loop, and make the challenge match.

findings.issue: The refusal envelope for agents on human-only routes is misstated. A12's normative order returns 403 AGNT_NOT_ALLOWED with gate G22 and a reason code (G22_SCOPE_NON_DELEGABLE or G22_AGENT_NEVER_CHECKER) for requiresHuman routes. A39's matrix and challenges assert the G22_* value as the refusal code, so the test would contradict A12.
findings.fix: Write the matrix column as '403 AGNT_NOT_ALLOWED, reason_codes [G22_...]' and assert both fields in the challenges.
